lot_holdout.method: unsigned first 8 hex characters of SHA-256(lot_id UTF-8), modulo 5 equals 0
lot_holdout.carry_in: report separately and exclude from training and primary evaluation

rolling_origin.label: first eligible non-entry ticket within ±3 elapsed days of target
rolling_origin.duplicate_labels: per animal and horizon keep closest target, then earliest origin
rolling_origin.training_cutoff: min(origin, development cutoff); training targets must be available by training cutoff

interval.calibration: horizon-specific empirical 5% and 95% signed residual quantiles from rolling development predictions only, equally weighted by lot
